deterministic.product_description: Rear lamp  — exterior lighting & signalling module combining multiple light functions, lens, and retro-reflector in a single housing.
deterministic.vehicle_category_note: M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.function: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the presence and width of the vehicle
parts.material: LED modules on PCB (light source); PC reflector with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
parts.evidence_drawing: Reflector callout text: 'rear position lamp: 4 to 17 cd on axis'

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.function: Emits red light of higher intensity to the rear to indicate service brake application
parts.evidence_drawing: LED modules on PCB callout text: 'stop lamp: 60 to 185 cd on axis'

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.function: Illuminates the road to the rear and warns other road users that the vehicle is reversing (white light)
parts.evidence_drawing: Housing callout text: 'reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard'; separate rectangular compartment visible in reflector and window area in outer lens

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Closes the lamp, transmits light and defines the emitted colour; protects internal optics
parts.regulated_function: outer lens (lens of signalling lamp; colour of emitted light - red)
parts.evidence_drawing: Front-most part in exploded view, callout 'Outer lens: red, within the chromaticity limits'; shows a distinct rectangular window region at upper right

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Passive reflection of incident light back towards its source for conspicuity of the vehicle rear
parts.evidence_drawing: Small rectangular hatched prism element between lens and seal, callout 'reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence'

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Structural body carrying optics, PCB and fasteners; attachment to vehicle body
parts.evidence_drawing: Rear-most deep tray-shaped part with fastening bosses at corners, labelled 'Housing'

parts.name: Reflector
parts.function: Metallised optical surface shaping and directing LED light for the individual lamp functions
parts.evidence_spec: | Reflector surface | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating |
parts.evidence_drawing: Part with array of cells for LEDs and two separate rectangular compartments, labelled 'Reflector'

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Light source and electronic circuit board carrying LEDs and drive/connection components
parts.evidence_spec: | Light source      | LED modules on PCB                          |
parts.evidence_drawing: Flat board with grid of LED elements, a connector-like component and a square component, labelled 'LED modules on PCB'

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals lens to housing against water and dust ingress
parts.evidence_drawing: Ring-shaped part following lens contour, callout 'no water ingress after the spray test'

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Mechanical attachment of the lamp, maintaining aim under vibration
parts.evidence_spec: | Fasteners / clips | PA, POM, or steel                           |
parts.evidence_drawing: Three screws/pins shown behind housing, callout 'lamp stays aimed under vibration'

electronic_subassemblies: LED modules on PCB (light source board with electronic components/connector)
model.light_sources: LED modules on PCB; replaceability not stated in spec - appear to be PCB-mounted non-replaceable LED light sources/modules (to be confirmed)
regulated_functions: outer lens (lens of signalling lamp; colour of emitted light - red)
search_terms: installation of lighting and light-signalling devices
drawing_observations: Exploded view along a common axis: outer lens, retro-reflector, seal/gasket, reflector, LED PCB, housing, three fasteners
Outer lens has a distinct rectangular window area at upper right, possibly for the reversing lamp (spec only states red-tinted PMMA; reversing lamp must emit white)
Retro-reflector is a separate small rectangular prism element placed between lens and seal
Reflector has an array of LED cells plus two separate rectangular compartments, suggesting separate optical chambers for different functions
PCB carries a grid of LED elements, a connector-like component and a square component
Housing shows fastening bosses at corners; three screws shown

Callout notes attach requirements to parts: rear position lamp 4 to 17 cd on axis, stop lamp 60 to 185 cd on axis, reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard, retro-reflector reflectivity at 5° incidence, no water ingress after spray test, lamp stays aimed under vibration
Some callout requirements are placed on components other than the function they describe (e.g. rear position lamp value on Reflector, reversing lamp visibility on Housing)
